response: Yes, nurse-led preoperative education can reduce anxiety and postoperative complications of patients undergoing cardiac surgery. Studies have shown that preoperative education provided by nurses can decrease patient anxiety, improve patient outcomes, and reduce postoperative complications such as pain, infection, and length of hospital stay. By providing patients with clear information about what to expect before, during, and after surgery, nurses can empower patients to take an active role in their care, leading to better health outcomes.
